upstream_schema_attribution.description: 4-tier claim-boundary catalog separating reported findings, mathematical reconstruction, transfer boundary, and explicit non-claims, paired with deterministic seed-locked Lane A vs. Lane B comparison.

entries.title: Inter-Embryo Ca2+ Wave Propagation & Poke-Evoked Spark Kinematics

reported: Mechanical poke stimulation of Xenopus/amphibian embryos evokes localized Ca2+ spark events and propagating wave fronts whose velocity, AP-axis distribution, and potential inter-embryo co-activation can be quantified via spark_tracks.csv and vector_clusters.csv.
reconstruction: Implemented in SimulationGenerator (generate_simulated_data.py) using elliptical embryo boundaries, AP coordinate projection (0=head, 1=tail), exponentially decaying spark area, and radial or directional random-walk cluster trajectories.

Deterministic paired A/B comparison (--compare-ab) locks the per-poke and per-cluster RNG stream across Lane A (e.g., inter-embryo signaling enabled or head-head orientation) and Lane B (e.g., single-embryo isolated control or reduced wave speed/coupling range), emitting paired delta curves for active tracks, total Ca2+ area, spatial spread, and secondary-embryo recruitment.
transfer_boundary: Embryo geometry is approximated as a 2D ellipse with specular/orthogonal boundary reflection rather than a 3D curved ectodermal epithelium.

Inter-embryo wave triggering is modeled via a thresholded Euclidean distance rule (dist < coupling_range_lengths * embryo.length) rather than explicit extracellular ATP diffusion, IP3 gap-junctional flux, or hydrodynamic mechanical coupling.
does_not_claim: Does not claim that synthetic spark trajectories prove a specific molecular carrier (e.g., ATP vs. Ca2+ vs. bioelectric field) without experimental pharmacological or gap-junctional controls.
Does not claim that simulated pixel coordinates require the manual Excel XY coordinate transform documented in COORDINATE_SYSTEM_WARNING.md.
